name: VisuallyHidden
description: Keeps text in the accessibility tree while taking it off the screen.

focusable.description: Reveal the content while focus is inside it, as a chip (surface plane, strong hairline, control height, control radius, focus ring) pinned to the top inline-start corner. Use it for skip links.

when: An icon-only control needs a name
A link's text is vague out of context
A skip link needs to hide until focused
whenNot: Nobody should see or hear it (render nothing)
The content is just collapsed (use aria-expanded)
guidelines: Say the action, not the icon: "Search", not "magnifier"
Keep it short — it is read aloud
Visible text beats hidden text whenever there is room
A skip link uses focusable, so it shows while it holds focus
accessibility: Screen readers announce it; the layout never moves
Focusable children inside still receive focus; with focusable they also become visible
Required for WCAG 2.1 on icon-only controls

examples.name: Icon Button Label
examples.description: The only thing telling a screen reader what this button does.

examples.name: Supplementary Text
examples.description: Gives a vague link the context sighted readers get from layout.

examples.name: Skip Link
examples.description: Hidden until focused, then it shows as a chip and jumps keyboard users past the nav.
examples.code: import { VisuallyHidden } from '@/components/VisuallyHidden'; Skip to main content

relations.note: Use inside icon-only buttons for accessible labels
Pair with icons to provide text alternatives

propsSummary: focusable: boolean - reveal as a chip while focus is inside (skip links)
Forwards standard DOM props (id, aria-*, data-*, className, handlers)
